requirements.title: Receive Raw NMEA Bytes from GPS Receiver
requirements.description: The GPS library shall receive raw NMEA byte data from the GPS receiver hardware interface.
requirements.rationale: Decomposes SW-REQ-SYS-001 and SW-REQ-SYS-024; raw NMEA acquisition is the library's primary responsibility.

requirements.title: Verbatim Pass-Through of NMEA Sentences
requirements.description: The GPS library shall expose received NMEA sentences to the caller without modifying their byte content.
requirements.rationale: Decomposes SW-REQ-SYS-024; verbatim raw NMEA logging requires the library not to alter bytes before parsing.

requirements.title: Support 5 Hz GPS Sampling
requirements.description: The GPS library shall deliver received NMEA sentences to the caller at a rate supporting 5 Hz sampling.
requirements.rationale: Decomposes SW-REQ-SYS-009; library throughput must support the system-mandated 5 Hz GPS sample rate.

requirements.title: Non-Blocking Read Interface
requirements.description: The GPS library shall provide a non-blocking read interface that returns within a caller-supplied timeout.
requirements.rationale: Decomposes SW-REQ-SYS-044; deterministic execution requires the library never to block the TDM scheduler indefinitely.

requirements.title: Power-On Self-Test Device Probe
requirements.description: The GPS library shall report at startup whether the GPS receiver is present and responsive.
requirements.rationale: Decomposes SW-REQ-SYS-029; POST requires probing each sensor device once at startup including the GPS.

requirements.title: Continuous GPS Health Reporting
requirements.description: The GPS library shall expose a health indicator reflecting whether NMEA data is flowing from the receiver.
requirements.rationale: Decomposes SW-REQ-SYS-031; continuous per-sensor health bitmap requires the library to surface its data-flow state.

requirements.title: Read Failure Status Reporting
requirements.description: The GPS library shall return a failure status code when a read from the GPS receiver fails.
requirements.rationale: Decomposes SW-REQ-SYS-031 and supports SW-REQ-SYS-033; explicit failure status enables caller to flag sensor unhealthy and continue.

requirements.title: POSIX Implementation Functional Equivalence
requirements.description: The GPS library shall provide a POSIX implementation functionally equivalent to the Pico2 implementation.
requirements.rationale: Decomposes SW-REQ-SYS-043; Trick simulation requires POSIX builds that exercise the same library API as flight.

requirements.title: Pico2 Implementation for Flight Hardware
requirements.description: The GPS library shall provide a Pico2 implementation that reads NMEA sentences from the flight UART.
requirements.rationale: Decomposes SW-REQ-SYS-043; flight hardware build requires a Pico2 implementation paired with the POSIX implementation.

requirements.title: Preserve Geodetic Position and HAE Altitude
requirements.description: The GPS library shall preserve the receiver's WGS-84 geodetic position and HAE altitude fields in delivered sentences.
requirements.rationale: Decomposes SW-REQ-SYS-038 and SW-REQ-SYS-039; verbatim pass-through must not corrupt the receiver's native WGS-84 / HAE output.
